question: In what sense is the realized person not born within the world?
premises: The person is situated in the world
He is said not to be born by birth
inference: Though appearing in the world, he is not truly born in bondage.
uncertainties: Vernacular suha, saṃsārasa, jyayi, necha have uncertain exact parsing
plain_english: He is in the world, yet not born by birth.
